customer: New to Eastvale and booked an appraisal for my station wagon. What do I need to bring?
agent: Welcome to Eastvale! Per our article "What to bring to your appraisal appointment," please bring a valid photo ID for every owner on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer statement (form NW-ODO-1), which you can also fill in at the store. If you still have a loan on the wagon, bring your payoff letter instead of the title, and if an owner can't attend, see "When more than one person owns the car." Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
